text: Sir? Can I sign up for the kid's parade?
Name?
Lucy and Vayne.
No.
Why?
Lucian, don't make this difficult.
We've got tourists here for the 300th anniversary.
If you lose control during the parade, who takes the blame?
I won't. If you're worried I'll scare people, I can wear a hat.
Hide my horns.
He's already a demon. Why dress up?
Yeah, just go as yourself.
A demon? Everybody run!
See? One little comment, and he loses it. Get out! Stop causing trouble.
Kids like that shouldn't be allowed out.
Kick him out of town.
I wasn't trying to burn anything. I wouldn't.
You can't take him a long way.
Get out of here!
Grown adults, ganging up on a six-year-old. Aren't you ashamed?
How much to sign him up?
It's not about money.
So you just don't like him?
Don't start with me, Elena. Everyone in town knows what that kid is.
He was asking nicely. You are the ones who cornered him and called him a monster.
You get to bully a kid, but one little flame makes him a public terrorist?
What if something happens?
What if? Then stay home! What if you trip and die?
Elena!
Was my husband at your shop again yesterday?
He came to fix a pipe. So what?
Three hours to fix a pipe? Who knows what you two were doing behind closed doors?
He's lousy at it. He tried twice, and it still leaks.
If you're that worried, lock him in the house.
Quit acting like every woman's after your husband.
You!
Since your husband died, you strut around dress like that.
All those men at your shop, you think we don't notice? They say you're a witch.
You put spells on men.
If I were, I'd break your husband's legs first.
Then you'd quit coming by every day after work to fix my pipes.
You shameless bitch!
You love showing off for men. Not so hot now, huh?
Betty, I'll shove that bucket over your head.
Fugitive Silas Crow, still wanted for multiple violent crimes committed years ago, has reportedly resurfaced here in recent days.
Crow is known to leave a pumpkin mask after every crime.
Police are urging residents to avoid going out alone after dark.
Damn cops, they've got this town locked down.
What the hell is this place?
Get off me! Get out of my body!
Three hundred years, they sealed me down here.
At last, I can taste freedom again.
Who the hell are you?
Moloch. The people of this town betrayed me, sealed me underground.
Now I'll make their descendants watch St. Valor fall.
What's that got to do with me?
You want to live? I want revenge. We need each other.
You.
I can send him the son of Satan.
Find him. Break my seal. For good.
I'll turn all of St. Valor into hell.
